title: REQ · Persistent world state serialization
summary: Serialize and restore GameState so changes such as an open secret door persist
description: Context: state is plain data. Desired behavior: serializeState/deserializeState convert GameState to and from JSON with validation, and the scene view reflects restored flags. Expected result: opening the secret door, saving, restoring and returning to the room shows it still open. Why: the world must remember meaningful actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a state, when serialized and deserialized, then the result deep-equals the original.
Given malformed JSON or missing fields, when deserialized, then an error is thrown.
Given the bookshelf searched, when state is round-tripped and getSceneView is called, then bookshelf open is true.
technical_constraints: Pure JSON string conversion, no storage access
